items.title: Starbucks Stock Gains 27% YTD: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: SBUX's 27.2% YTD rally reflects stronger traffic, margin recovery and raised guidance, but consumer uncertainty and input costs remain key risks.

items.title: Wendy’s names Tariq Hassan chief marketing and customer growth officer
items.summary: The fast-food chain has named the former McDonald’s marketing executive to a key role as it works on its comeback.

items.title: Domino's Stock Slips 15% in 6 Months: Should You Buy, Hold or Sell?
items.summary: DPZ's 15.3% six-month slide reflects weak ticket trends and margin pressure, but order growth, loyalty gains and a discounted valuation support a hold.

items.title: Wendy’s CEO Aims for Chain to Get Back in the Burger Fight
items.summary: Bob Wright said that the chain has traded quality for cost savings and that a former McDonald’s executive is joining as marketing chief.

items.title: Wendy’s hires ex-McDonald’s CMO as chief marketing, customer growth officer
items.summary: Tariq Hassan will succeed Lindsay Radkoski, U.S. CMO since 2023, as the chain continues to execute a turnaround plan.

items.title: McDonald’s Just Started Selling Energy Drinks. How to Play MCD Stock Here.
items.summary: McDonald’s energy-drink push could give MCD stock a fresh catalyst after a roughly 11% 2026 decline.

items.title: How Durable Is CAVA's 9% Comps Growth Amid Food-Safety Concerns?
items.summary: CAVA's 9% Q2 comps growth and 5.3% traffic gain highlight resilient demand, while food-safety concerns test near-term sales momentum.

items.title: Trump’s 90-Day Inflation Band-Aid: Why His Beef Tariff Pause Won’t Help Consumers
items.summary: Trump's 90-day beef tariff pause promises relief at the grocery store, but the cattle biology and market forces quietly working against it could make the cure worse than the disease.
